What This Actually Is and Why It Matters

Automated digital product delivery with cryptocurrency is not just a workaround for platform restrictions - it's a full-stack infrastructure solution that gives you complete control over your commerce operations. By using tools like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and NOWPayments, you can create a sovereign digital commerce stack that's decentralized, secure, and free from intermediaries. This means you can sell ebooks, courses, templates, and software without relying on Stripe, PayPal, or Gumroad, and keep 100% of your revenue.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture behind automated digital product delivery with cryptocurrency is built around a series of interconnected components. Cloudflare Pages hosts your store, while Cloudflare Workers handles backend logic and order processing. Supabase or Google Sheets store order data, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 deliver files directly to customers. Meanwhile, NOWPayments handles cryptocurrency payments and conversions, ensuring that you receive your revenue in USD. The result is a seamless and secure commerce experience that's tailored to your needs.

Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link before the test download link expires. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields. Publish your store URL and review your first week of orders in the database to confirm the automated pipeline is running correctly.
